plugins.name: @aryacode/dsh-plugin-arya-computer-use
plugins.title: Arya Computer Use
plugins.description: Drives Windows apps through accessibility controls with a takeover overlay that frames the driven window, shows a ghost cursor where Arya acts, and stops on Esc. Includes a browser lane (agent-browser) with sign-in profiles and attach-to-my-Chrome.
plugins.author: AryaCode
